milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the campfire at spawn-relative (3, 0, 6) and face toward it, modeling that they can see it. max_distance=10 is generous since the campfire has visible smoke/flames. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted red mushroom is inside the cottage at spawn-relative (7, 1, 7). max_distance=5 requires the player to be close (inside or at the doorway of the cottage) to see the small potted mushroom on the floor. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.
